card.name: Punctuation inside reference author lists
card.fires_on: Commas, semicolons and "al" right after an author's initials in a citation list. It fires in the middle of a reference, before the next author name or before "et al".

modes.label: Separator after initials
modes.description: A comma, semicolon or period-comma that follows an author's initials and precedes the next author.
modes.example: Aakeröy, C.B.; Hurley, E.P.; Desper, J<<.;>> Natali, M.; Douglawi

modes.label: "al" in et al
modes.description: The word "al" ending "et al" after a list of authors in a reference.
modes.example: Van Kerkhove MD, Asikainen T, Becker NG, Bjorge S, Desenclos J-C, et<< al>>. (2010). Studies

card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where one author's name ends and the next begins, or where the list is cut short with et al.
